newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AptarGroup Inc upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AptarGroup Inc upgraded.

text.p: -- Salomon Bros said it raised its recommendation on AptarGroup Inc to strong buy from hold "based on improved earnings prospects, increased earnings conviction and attractive valuation."

-- "The stock is 31 percent off its high and now sells for an unsustainably cheap 12.6 times 1998 earnings per share estimate of $2.60. On an enterprise value to EBITDA (cash flow) basis, the company's valued at only five times cash flow," the analyst said.
